headline: Proposed US Investment Curbs Threaten China Biotech Licensing
summary: Chinese biotech firms face fresh headwinds in global expansion as US Treasury Department draft rules threaten to disrupt deal structures.
why: Cross-border biotech licensing deals are a critical growth driver for emerging pharmaceutical firms seeking access to Western capital and markets.

impacts.name: Biotechnology
impacts.why: New outbound investment curbs make it harder for Chinese biotech firms to attract direct US funding and structure partnerships.
